headline: You rode 12 km past the prescription and still held race effort doing it - but there is no run file again.
body:
The bike leg of yesterday's brick was the strongest ride of this block. **96.83 km in 4:01 at a weighted 142 bpm**, against 85 km prescribed at 140-150 - and **1,775 m of climbing, 18.3 m/km against race day's 6**. The 19-minute gap at 08:40 is the watch auto-splitting one ride, not a stop, so 96.8 km is a floor.

No run is recorded. Both rides were in the file by the 19:20 sync, and this morning's has not landed yet, so a late upload is possible but I would not bet on it. Did the run happen and the battery go, or did you call it after four hours? That split is the one number this block still owes me.

Today is rest and after 1,775 m it stays rest - no spin, nothing.

How is the right ankle this morning?
